claude_only.name: Which identifier is the authoritative master-system identifier for this site, and which system issues and maintains it?
Which governed global identifiers or IRIs resolve to this site, and what persistence guarantee does each carry?
If no external authoritative identifier exists, what UUID or ULID has the adopting Dimension assigned, and when?
What official, legal, trading and wayfinding names does the site carry, in which languages, and which is canonical?
Under what conditions may this identifier be retired, and may it ever be reassigned to a different site?
Against which governed classification schemes is this site classified, and what is the scheme version for each assigned value?
Can the site hold more than one classification at the same time, and how are conflicting values reconciled?
Is this record a site complex, a site, or a site section, and what does that imply for its parent and child records?
What events oblige the site to be reclassified, and who may authorise the change?
What written rule determines whether a given area, facility or network falls inside this site's managed extent?
Is the site contiguous, and if not, what are its separate parts and what justifies treating them as one site?
Which areas inside the outer boundary are excluded from the managed extent, and who controls them?
Who has authority to change the managed extent, and what evidence must accompany such a change?
What geometry represents the site boundary, and in which coordinate reference system and vertical datum is it expressed?
What is the positional accuracy of the boundary, and by what survey or capture method was it derived?
What single reference point represents the site for coarse location and relative placement, and how is it defined?
Does the managed extent include airspace, subsurface volume or water column, and to what stated limits?
Where does the operational boundary diverge from the legal parcel line, and how is that divergence recorded?
Which cadastral parcels or equivalent legal land units does the managed extent cover, wholly or partly?
Under what tenure does the operator hold each parcel or part, and for what term?
Which easements, rights of way, wayleaves or covenants constrain how the site may be used?
Which register or authority is the source of truth for each tenure statement, and when was it last verified?
At which points does the site connect to the public transport network, and what are the constraints on each?
Which addresses are associated with the site, for which purpose, and which is the emergency response address?
Where is the demarcation point for each incoming utility, and who is responsible on each side of it?
What land uses and sensitive receptors adjoin the site, and what obligations do they create?
Which facilities does this site contain, and what identifier does each carry in the facility model?
For each contained facility, is the relationship exclusive containment or a non-exclusive reference, and can a facility belong to two sites?
Where does site responsibility end and facility responsibility begin for services, structure and information?
Which facilities on the site are owned or operated by a party other than the site operator, and what does the site record hold about them?
Which distribution and drainage networks does the site own or operate, and what does each serve?
What record exists of buried and concealed infrastructure, at what confidence, and when was it last verified?
What capacity and redundancy does each on-site network provide, and what is its current headroom?
At what point does each on-site network hand over to a facility or to an external operator?
How is the site surface distributed across land cover and surface types, and by what area measure?
Which ecological, heritage or protected features exist on the site, and what constraints do they impose?
Which open areas are designated for parking, laydown, storage or circulation, and what are their capacities?
Who is responsible for maintaining each category of open space, and under what service arrangement?
Which zoning schemes apply to this site, and what zones does each define?
Where do zones from different schemes overlap, and which scheme governs when their rules conflict?
Which parts of the site are in a development, construction, commissioning or decommissioning phase, and until when?
Who may create, alter or dissolve a zone, and what record captures that decision?
What internal route network exists for vehicles, pedestrians and goods, and what restrictions apply to each route?
Which gates, barriers and control points sit on the internal network, and what is each capable of enforcing?
Which routes are designated as step-free or otherwise accessible, and when was this last verified?
What routes and hardstanding are reserved for emergency vehicle access, and what keeps them clear?
Who is the legal owner of the site, who operates it, and are they the same party?
Which named role carries statutory duty-holder accountability for the site, and for which duties?
What decisions has the accountable party delegated to site management, and what limits apply?
How is a change of owner, operator or duty holder recorded, and what must be transferred with it?
Which permits, licences and consents does the site hold, from which authority, and with what validity period?
Which conditions attached to each authorisation constrain site operations or trigger reporting?
In which regulatory registries does this site appear, under what registry identifier, and does the registry record match the managed extent?
What are the renewal, variation and surrender triggers for each authorisation, and who owns each action?
What physically constitutes the site perimeter, and which entry and exit points are designated for access enforcement?
Who authorises physical access to the site and to each security zone, and on what basis is authorisation granted and revoked?
How are visitors and contractors identified, escorted and accounted for while on site?
What physical access records are captured at each point, and how long are they retained?
How are keys, cards and other physical access devices inventoried, and when are combinations changed?
How is each class of site information classified for sensitivity, and who assigns the classification?
Which site details must be withheld or redacted before information leaves the controlled environment, and on what basis?
Which site information must be published or disclosed on request regardless of the operator's preference?
Where a disclosure obligation conflicts with a security restriction, what process resolves it and who decides?
What controlled vocabulary of site states applies, and which state is current as at which effective date?
Who may authorise each state transition, and what evidence must exist before the transition is recorded?
When a site is split, merged or partly transferred, how are predecessor and successor identifiers linked?
For every recorded change, what are the event time and the observation or ingestion time, and do they differ?
Which foreseeable and unforeseeable trigger events require the site record to be updated, and within what timescale?
What operating hours and seasonal or shift regimes apply to the site and to individual zones?
What rules must every person on site comply with, and what induction or competence is required before entry?
Which activities on this site require a permit to work or equivalent control, and who issues them?
Which facility services are provided across the site, by whom, and under what agreed performance levels?
To which natural hazards is the site exposed, at what assessed severity and return period, and from which authoritative dataset?
What is the known contamination status of the site's ground and groundwater, and what remediation history exists?
Which hazardous substances or processes are present on site, in what quantities, and what regulatory thresholds do they engage?
How current is each hazard and environmental assessment, and what triggers reassessment?
Is a written emergency action plan required for this site, and where is the current approved version held?
What evacuation type, exit route assignments and muster points apply, and how are all persons accounted for afterwards?
What employee alarm system is in place, what distinct signals does it use, and how is it maintained and tested?
Who has assigned emergency duties including rescue, medical and critical-operations roles, and what triggers a review of the plan with them?
What arrangements exist with external emergency responders, including site access, hazard briefing and rendezvous points?
Which area measures are recorded for the site, on what measurement basis, and in which units?
Where the measured site area differs from registered parcel area values, which prevails for which purpose?
What occupancy or population does the site carry, measured how and over what period?
What capacity limits constrain the site, and which are regulatory rather than physical?
For each reporting scheme, what boundary is drawn over the site, and how does it differ from the managed extent?
Is the site represented as a parent property with child properties, and what aggregation rules apply?
Which meters serve the whole site versus individual facilities, and how is shared plant consumption allocated?
Which greenhouse-gas consolidation approach applies to this site, and which scopes are reported for it?
What is the completeness and quality of each reported quantity, and how much is estimated?
Which observable properties of the site are monitored, on which features of interest, and by which sensors or platforms?
For each observation, what is the phenomenon time and what is the result time, and how is the difference handled?
Which monitoring is mandated by an authorisation or standard rather than chosen by the operator?
How is the quality of site monitoring data established, including calibration, drift and gap handling?
Which record evidences each material assertion about the site, and what is that record's status and suitability?
For each record, who produced it, from what inputs, by what method, and who approved it?
How is a record known to be current, and how are superseded versions marked and retained?
What retention period applies to each record class, on what legal basis, and what is the approved disposal action?
Which common data environment is the agreed source of information for this site, and how is access to it controlled?
To which external schemas is this site record aligned, at which version, and is the alignment full or partial?
What information is lost, generalised or forced in each mapping, and what compensating record is kept?
By what rules is this site matched to a candidate record in an external system, and what confidence does a match carry?
What evidence supports any claim of conformance to an external standard, and where a claim cannot be evidenced how is it recorded?
Which elements of an aligned schema are deprecated, and how are they handled in exchange?

grok_only.name: What is the authoritative master-system identifier for this site, and which register (operator asset register, statutory land register, or other) is the source of truth?
What governed global identifier or IRI is assigned (IFC GlobalId, INSPIRE inspireId, or other persistent IRI), and is it permanent?
What UUID or ULID did the adopting Dimension assign, and when was it minted versus when was the identity first observed?
Which statutory LandID and LandTitleID values apply, and do they identify one parcel, several parcels, or a title that is not coincident with the operational site?
If operator site codes, cadastral references and BIM GlobalIds disagree, which identifier wins for operations, legal notice and model exchange?
What is the public or campus name, the legal/title name, and any construction or project designation currently in force?
What postal address is assigned to the site, and does it locate the whole campus or only a gatehouse, mailroom or one parcel?
Who authorised the current public name, when did it take effect, and which previous names remain as aliases?
Is this instance classified as a construction site, operational campus, industrial site, mixed-use holding, or another documented class, and which classification system is used?
Is the IFC composition type COMPLEX (site complex), ELEMENT (site) or PARTIAL (site section), and if campus, is it one ELEMENT or a COMPLEX of disconnected sites?
If called a campus, are member parcels or sites contiguous, and is non-contiguous satellite land in or out of the same campus identity?
What user-defined ObjectType or national building-code classification reference further specialises the site?
What coordinate reference system, including datum, projection and epoch, is authoritative for this site?
What easting, northing, orthogonal height, scale and rotation define the map conversion from the engineering system to the CRS?
If approximate WGS84 latitude, longitude and elevation are stored on the site, what is their precision and are they consistent with the map conversion?
When was the georeference surveyed (event time) and when was it ingested into this model (observation time)?
What geometry represents the operational site or campus envelope, in which CRS, and at which level of detail?
What cadastral or title geometries are bound to this site, and where do they differ from the operational envelope?
Does the managed holding include air rights, subsurface strata or water column, and how is vertical extent recorded?
Which holes, public roads, third-party inholdings or water bodies are excluded from the operational site?
Which cadastral parcels, basic property units or SpatialUnit identifiers are bound to this site, and is the binding complete?
Is the campus represented as a LADM SpatialUnitGroup of parcels, and what grouping criterion (common title, common operator, common security perimeter) is used?
If some occupied land is unregistered, customary or informal, how is that spatial unit recorded without claiming cadastral completeness?
Are condominium, strata or air-right units present, and do they fragment the site's vertical or horizontal management?
Does this site belong to a site complex, and which sibling sites are connected or disconnected members of that complex?
Which facilities, buildings and civil works are aggregated under this site, and which product elements are merely contained or referenced?
How is the site decomposed into sections or areas, and is that decomposition spatial, operational or both?
Which external works, landscape, roads, fences and other siteworks are part of the site rather than of a child facility?
Which elements (shared utilities, roads, security fences) are referenced by more than one spatial structure and how is primary containment chosen?
Which enterprise identity determines this ISA-95 site, and is the grouping physical, geographical or logical?
Which areas, work centres and work units are children of this site in the role-based equipment hierarchy?
If the ISA-95 site is logical, which physical WM-BLT-008 holdings does it overlay, and is a geometry-less site allowed as a canonical instance?
Who is the legal owner or owners of the land and of the improvements, and under which title or lease instruments?
Who is the site or campus operator, and is facility management insourced, outsourced or co-sourced?
Which rights, restrictions and responsibilities (including informal or customary) bind parties to this holding?
If ownership or operatorship transferred, when did the event occur, and was the asset information model transferred with it?
Which planning or building-code authority sets development controls for this site, and which zoning or plan-unit designations apply?
What are the current buildable area, site coverage ratio, floor-area ratio, height limit and total planned area?
Which easements, rights of way, superficie or other interests in land encumber the site, and which facilities do they protect or restrict?
If local code, campus master plan and recorded easements conflict, which constraint is binding for a proposed development?
What is the current lifecycle state of the holding (planned, under construction, operational, mothballed, decommissioning, restored), and when did that state begin?
Which ISO 19650-3 trigger events are scheduled or have occurred, and did they open a delivery-phase PIM or an operational AIM update?
Where are the current asset information model and any contributing project information models, and what was transferred at points A and B?
If the site is being decommissioned, what restoration, residual-risk and information-archive obligations remain?
Is this instance a permanent holding, a time-bounded construction site of the work, or a secondary/support site, and what are its start and planned end times?
Which secondary construction or adjacent support sites are linked to the primary site of the work, and are they inside the permanent campus?
Does a labour-law site-of-the-work envelope differ from the operational campus, and which activities are excluded as general manufacturing?
Is any part of this holding a known or suspected contaminated site or CERCLA/RCRA facility, and what is the regulatory list status?
Who are the potentially responsible or permitted parties for contamination, and how do they relate to the land owner and site operator?
What removal or remedial actions are active, and how do they constrain construction, occupancy or transfer of the site?
What is the default physical access regime for this site (public, controlled, restricted, classified), and which perimeters and gates enforce it?
Which site information (geometry, occupancy, utilities) is security-sensitive under ISO 19650-5 principles, and who may read it?
Is the entire campus a single workplace/establishment or are multiple workplaces recorded, and what exceptions exist for public realm?
What emergency-access exceptions (fire, medical, environmental response) override the default access rule?
What are the measured gross area, perimeter and optional volume, in which units, and by which method?
How does planned TotalArea and BuildableArea differ from measured GrossArea, and which value is used for which decision?
What positional accuracy, completeness and logical consistency are claimed for the site geometry, and what evidence supports the claim?
Which validation rules failed or passed (CRS consistency, parcel coverage, FAR not exceeded, identifier uniqueness)?
Which IfcSite GlobalId, composition type and georeferencing mode map this instance, and is LandTitleNumber avoided in IFC4.3 ADD2 export?
If published into a city model, is the campus a CityObjectGroup, a LandUse object, both, or unmapped, and at which LOD?
Which standards is this instance claimed to conform to, and what evidence exists versus mere alignment?
How long are site geometry, title extracts, AIM snapshots and access logs retained, and what is deleted or anonymised on decommission?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
